profile.headline: Lead Mobile Software Engineer at Juniper
profile.summary:
Results-focused, technically driven Software Engineer with diverse background in application development, requirements analysis, sprint management and solution engineering. 

My passion is good code and quality applications, but am equally competent and confident in the business side of things. I write excellent code and also bridge the big picture to technical specification gap as needed.

Specialties: Objective-C, Java, Jira

positions.title: Mobile Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.description:
Lead the mobile team in developing and maintaining applications and SDKs related to Junipers indoor location technology and network devices.

Engage with different stake holders to understand the requirements and business needs of customers. Work in between product management and the development teams to create new features for our products that solves their needs. I manage the development process of every feature from inception, through software architecture, planning, requirements confirmation, technical issues resolution, testing,  store and repo release, etc... including expectation management.

Code workload for the applications and the SDK in both iOS and Android.

The mobile team works on 4 applications and a location SDKs
Mist Experience - Demo application for location based services (iOS & Android)
Mist Validation - Internal testing tool for location services (iOS & Android)
Mist AI - Provision and maintain Juniper devices (iOS & Android)
Marvis Client - Device agent that reports key information to the networks cloud AI (Android currently, Windows and MacOS coming)
Location SDK - Indoor location SDK (iOS & Android)

positions.title: Senior iOS Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Integral team member of the Mobile Team 
•	Design and implement new MAM Features using:
      •	BlackBerry SDK
      •	Microsoft InTune SDK
•	Resolve difficult MAM related issues / bugs
•	Provide customer guidance on architectural implementation

positions.title: Senior iOS Software Engineer
positions.description:
BlackBerry Work iOS Software Engineer
•	Integral team member of BlackBerry Work
•	Design and implement new features of BlackBerry Work
•	Perform code reviews
•	Resolve difficult issues / bugs

positions.title: Solutions Architect / Lead Software Engineer for Professional Services
positions.description:
Custom Application Development

•	Develop customized version of Good for Enterprise (iOS)
•	Develop provisioning application for Good that simplifies the activation process
•	Develop demo applications for use by Sales Engineers to demonstrate the features and capabilities of Good Dynamics (iOS)
•	Develop Custom Self-service Portal (Java)
•	Develop Server tools that help integrate Good’s servers into a customers enterprise (Objective C, Java, .net)
•	Migration Utilities
•	Reporting tools
•	Audit and Compliance tools
•	Single Sign On adapters (SAML 2.0)

Consulting and education for customers and ISV partners (developer focused)

•	Provide developer training (developer kitchens / webinars) on how to use the Good Dynamics SDK for iOS, Android and PhoneGap/Cordova Applications
•	Provide architectural overview of Good Dynamics enabled Solutions
•	Deep dive of server and client side features
•	Web Services implementation of server modules
•	Provide sample applications and training labs per customer requirement
•	Provide architectural and technical guidance

Software Engineer Lead for Professional Services 
Responsible for end-to-end delivery of custom solutions that compliment our core product offerings
•	Engage the customers to understand their requirements
•	Work with the customers to formulate a solution
•	Develop solutions / provide guidance and oversight to partners developing the solutions
•	Assist in deployment of solutions
•	Assist in application maintenance and support
i.e. Developed a PhoneGap/Cordova plugin to expose our Good Dynamics (GD) security APIs to hybrid/HTML5 application developers [PhoneGap/Cordova, JavaScript, Objective-C, QUnit, GD SDK]

positions.title: Analyst
positions.description:
Interface with all wholesale related application teams
•	Understand their user authentication and authorization structure
•	Provide guidance with on-boarding applications with the bank’s Access Certification Application

Create and generate reports using SQL and SSRS for format and data exceptions with the user authentication and authorization data sent by the applications

positions.title: iOS Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Develop iPad application for pier-to-pier payment processing
•	Coordinate requirements with key business unit 
•	User Interface layout and design
•	Code the application in Objective-C 
•	Create classes to interface with REST web services using JSON, XML and NSUrl
•	Access web services for authentication, authorization and payment processing
•	Add capability to generate and scan barcodes

positions.title: Business Analyst for Access Management
positions.description:
•	Gather IAM requirements, analyze, and develop high level and detailed functional and technical documents as it pertains to ICW and the functional tracks involved (Order, Sell, Quoting, Service, Manage Financials, User Profile, User Experience, Build and Deliver, Work Space)
•	Document workflow
•	As-is and to-be
•	Provide updates, assistance and expertise to other ICW tracks
•	Highlight and help resolve issues/risks

•	Document the ICW requirements in a BRD and worked with IAM internally and other tracks in ICW to get approval / sign-off on the BRD.

•	Interface with multiple groups to understand current and future business processes. Facilitate requirements gathering meetings to define and document business requirements.

•	Contribute to and understand architectural considerations and principles for Access Management databases, applications, and processes

•	Act as liaison between groups by planning, conducting, and directing the analysis of business problems and requirements

•	Coordinate test environment set-up and user set-up with IT Teams

positions.title: Data Configuration Manager
positions.description:
InSite Vendor Management System  
•	Configure the InSite website instance for clients based on their organizational structure and data, to enable an easy process of hiring consultants from Adecco or other vendors to meet their requirements. These included the following processes and modules:
•	Ordering / Submitting Job Requirements
•	Quoting and Forwarding Candidates
•	Contract Approval
•	Consultant Time Tracking and Billing

Data and Process Analysis

•	Work with the delivery team and other cross functional groups to discover the data structures, process flows and company hierarchy of new or transitioning companies
•	Interface with multiple groups to understand and coordinate an InSite deployment plan that includes:
•	User hierarchy
•	Approval Management and Work Flow
•	Rate Structure (Job Title to Work Site) management
•	Supplier (Vendor) priority / neutrality settings
•	Financial Data Configuration (Task Codes, Expense Codes)
•	Company Structure (Cost Centers, Business Units, Worksites)
•	Worker Data (Job Posting Templates)

Data Configuration and Load

•	Data Gap Analysis
•	Data consolidation, cleaning and formatting
•	Partial data deployment to test website
•	Data deployment to production website

Technical Customer Support 

•	Provide technical support on the solution implemented
•	Technical support for Rate grid management

positions.title: Business & Data Analyst + Channels Support
positions.description:
Process Analysis and Design

•	Create and pilot “Integrated Services”, a program that allowed customers to get discounts for hardware based on bundled service contracts. 
•	Create a framework for Integrated Services based on the Upgrade Returns Program
•	Socialize the concept with key departments and geographies to get program buy-in and discover their requirements
•	Coordinate with the software development team to ensure business requirements for the supporting database are clear to all
•	Interface with multiple groups to understand current and future business processes. Facilitate requirements gathering meetings to define and document business requirements 
•	Work with the RMA team on issues that come up that are outside normal SOP. Find a resolution to the issues and adjust procedures and guidelines “if” and “as needed”
•	Act as liaison between groups by planning, conducting, and directing the analysis of business problems and requirements

Upgrade Allowance and Integrated Services Credit

•	Create reports for master resellers with the details and totals the amount that Sun will credit them for upgrade or integrated service sales
•	Reconcile with master resellers any discrepancies on the credits applied

Analysis and Development

•	Gather requirements, analyze, and develop high level and detailed functional and technical documents for enhancements to STARS (RMA tracking database) and SunReturns (web application for processing returns)
•	Develop functions/modules in a supplemental application to STARS (RMA tracking database) using VB.NET, ADO.NET & XML files

Ad-Hoc Reporting / Data Analysis

•	Create reports for master resellers and Sun, using SQL / Brio to query data from SunReturns (web application for processing returns) and STARS 

Technical and Logistical Support for Sun Partners and Customers
•	Assist the RMA Returns team and related teams within Sun to resolve technical and/or procedural issues
